scene_jp: <ruby>東京<rt>とうきょう</rt></ruby><ruby>駅<rt>えき</rt></ruby>のコンコースは、<ruby>何千<rt>なんぜん</rt></ruby>もの<ruby>人<rt>ひと</rt></ruby>が<ruby>行<rt>い</rt></ruby>き<ruby>交<rt>か</rt></ruby>う<ruby>広<rt>ひろ</rt></ruby>い<ruby>空間<rt>くうかん</rt></ruby>だ。<ruby>天井<rt>てんじょう</rt></ruby>は<ruby>高<rt>たか</rt></ruby>く、<ruby>足音<rt>あしおと</rt></ruby>がどこか<ruby>遠<rt>とお</rt></ruby>くで<ruby>響<rt>ひび</rt></ruby>いている。そのとき、<ruby>制服<rt>せいふく</rt></ruby>を<ruby>着<rt>き</rt></ruby>た<ruby>老<rt>ろう</rt></ruby>いた<ruby>駅員<rt>えきいん</rt></ruby>が、テストの<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>立<rt>た</rt></ruby>ち<ruby>止<rt>と</rt></ruby>まった。「あなたが<ruby>出口<rt>でぐち</rt></ruby>で<ruby>拾<rt>ひろ</rt></ruby>ったものを、<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>せていただけますか。」と、<ruby>静<rt>しず</rt></ruby>かに<ruby>言<rt>い</rt></ruby>った。<ruby>彼<rt>かれ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>目<rt>め</rt></ruby>は、テストのことを<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>から<ruby>知<rt>し</rt></ruby>っていたかのように<ruby>落<rt>お</rt></ruby>ち<ruby>着<rt>つ</rt></ruby>いていた。
scene_translation: The concourse of Tokyo Station is a vast space where thousands of people cross paths. The ceiling soars high above, and the sound of footsteps echoes somewhere far away. Just then, an elderly station attendant in uniform stopped directly in front of you. "Could you show me what you picked up at the exit?" he said quietly. His eyes were calm — as if he had known about you all along.
grammar_note: 【〜かのように】 means 'as if' — it describes something that looks or feels like a certain situation, even if it isn't true. Here: 「<ruby>前<rt>まえ</rt></ruby>から<ruby>知<rt>し</rt></ruby>っていたかのように<ruby>落<rt>お</rt></ruby>ち<ruby>着<rt>つ</rt></ruby>いていた」 = 'he was calm, as if he had known all along.' Also note this NPC's speech is keigo (です/ます, 〜ていただけますか) — very polite and formal compared to ordinary station staff.

to come and go, to pass each other
to stop (while walking), to come to a halt
to be calm, to settle down
to show (humble/polite form of 見せてもらう)

mystery_memo: The old station attendant Morimoto knows the player's name and somehow knows they picked something up at the exit — deepening the central mystery of who is watching and why. His calm, knowing demeanor suggests he is a key figure: possibly a guardian, a messenger, or someone who has been expecting the player. The item picked up at the exit (not yet defined in inventory) is clearly significant. Player's choice here will establish whether Morimoto becomes an ally or a suspicious figure.
